title: Master Domain Index schemas
description: JSON Schema for the two Master Domain Index layers: a per-ecosystem file (domains/ecosystems/<ecosystem>.json) and the curated class-to-persona matrix (domains/classes.json). Validated in-repo by a small schema-subset interpreter (src/pipeline/domainIndex.ts and scripts/build-domain-index.mjs); the keywords used below (type, required, properties, additionalProperties, propertyNames, items, enum, minLength, minItems, minProperties, $ref) are the full set that interpreter supports.

classVocabulary.description: The fixed, 14-value class vocabulary. Ecosystem files may use any subset; classes.json must define all 14.

personaVocabulary.description: The 12 built-in reviewer persona ids (PERSONA_CHARTERS in .github/workflows/pipelines/review-pipeline.js).

globList.description: One or more glob patterns, ported git/CodeRabbit-style semantics (** crosses zero-or-more segments, * stays within one segment, ? one char, {a,b} alternation). Matched against the full repo-relative path.

personaList.description: Zero or more persona ids from personaVocabulary. Empty is legitimate (e.g. the assets class).

ecosystemFile.description: Layer 1: one file per ecosystem, mapping class names to glob patterns.

classesFile.description: Layer 2: the curated matrix mapping every one of the 14 classes to its persona ids.
